{{Top|leg}}
The '''Nalmar residence''' was a mansion owned by [[Ral Nalmar]], head of the [[Nalmar Family|Nalmar crime family]]. It was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mennia]]. The building was attacked by forces loyal to [[Qual'om Soach]]. During the attack, most members of the Nalmar crime family including Ral, his wife [[Emie Nalmar|Emie]], and their son [[Death/Legends|died]].
